note: Verbatim facts from DigitalOcean's Bandwidth Billing page: rates, the team-level pool, the per-second accrual, and the two products that bill bandwidth differently from Droplets.

accrual.rule: For every second a Droplet exists it accrues 1/2,419,200 of its plan's transfer allowance towards the team pool, capped at 2,419,200 seconds (28 days) per monthly billing cycle.

free_cases: Inbound transfer to Droplets is free.
Data transfer between Droplets over the VPC private network is not billed (it uses a private interface).
Outbound transfer that DigitalOcean determines was dropped by a DigitalOcean firewall rule is not billed.
All IPv6 traffic uses the public interface, so it counts against the pool.

other_products.note: 1,024 GiB of outbound transfer shared between all buckets; some region pairs to Droplets are free.
Additional outbound transfer is $0.02 per GiB, twice the Droplet rate; inbound is free.

quote_pool_example: If one Droplet uses 1,500 GiB and another 100 GiB against a 2,000 GiB team pool, they cumulatively used 1,600 GiB, so no overage fees apply.
quote_accrual_example: A Droplet whose plan includes 1,000 GiB accrues about 0.0004 GiB of allowance per second towards the team pool.
